author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices a swinging steady beat, high and low, loud and soft, stop and go, and playing together, with an old circle game.

classes.title: Round and round we go
classes.goal: Feel the swinging beat of the song by moving in a little circle together.

mathTarget.parentLine: Feeling a swing that comes back again and again

classes.parentPrompt: Hold your child and walk or rock in a small circle, stepping on each big beat.
classes.childAction: Go round and round with your grown-up, swaying to the song.
classes.bridge: The beat swings like a gentle hammock: swing, swing, round the bush.

intro.caption: Round and round we go
intro.parentCue: hold your child and step in a small circle

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: feeling the swinging beat, together.

classes.title: Two big swings
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap on each big swinging beat while the grown-up plays.

mathTarget.parentLine: This song swings in twos: one, two, one, two

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand over your child's hand and tap together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key on each big swing. Any key is right.
classes.bridge: Each tap is one swing of the hammock: one, two, one, two.

intro.caption: One swing, one tap
intro.parentCue: say 'one, two' softly with the swings

games.caption: Here we go round
games.parentCue: Tap two big taps with this line

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: tapping a swinging beat in twos.

classes.title: Bear low, bird high
classes.goal: Hear low and high sounds and tap the matching side of the piano.

mathTarget.parentLine: Low sounds live on the left, high sounds on the right

classes.parentPrompt: Crouch and growl for the bear; stretch up and flap for the bird.
classes.childAction: Bear sound: tap the left side. Bird sound: tap the right.
classes.bridge: The bear sits low under the bush; the bird sits high on top.

intro.caption: Bear lives low, bird lives high
intro.parentCue: point left for bear, right for bird

games.caption: Down low, then up high
games.parentCue: Crouch on the low notes, stretch on high

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing high and low sounds.

classes.title: Stomp, stomp, tiptoe
classes.goal: Tap the beat with big loud taps, then with tiny soft taps.

mathTarget.parentLine: Noticing big and small: the same tap, more or less

classes.parentPrompt: Make big strong arms for loud taps; whisper and tiptoe your fingers for soft.
classes.childAction: Loud: big stomping taps. Soft: tiny tiptoe taps.
classes.bridge: Loud taps are big boots round the bush; soft taps are tiptoes.

intro.caption: Big stomps, tiny tiptoes
intro.parentCue: loud means strong arms, not banging

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing loud and soft.

classes.title: Turtle and bunny circle
classes.goal: Follow the music as it slows like a turtle and speeds like a bunny.

mathTarget.parentLine: Same tune, same shape, only the speed changes

classes.parentPrompt: Circle your finger on your child's back, slowly then quickly, matching the music.
classes.childAction: Turtle music: slow taps. Bunny music: quick taps.
classes.bridge: Slow taps are a turtle going round the bush; fast taps are a bunny.

intro.caption: Turtle slow, bunny fast
intro.parentCue: slow down if the taps get wild

games.caption: Bunny goes round
games.parentCue: Same song, now quick and light

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: following slow and fast music.

classes.title: Freeze and wash hands
classes.goal: Tap while the music plays; when it stops, freeze, then pretend to wash hands.

mathTarget.parentLine: When the sound stops, the hands stop too

classes.parentPrompt: When the music stops, freeze, then rub your hands together like washing; cheer at the restart.
classes.childAction: Tap while music plays. Freeze when it stops, then wash hands.
classes.bridge: Music on, we go round the bush; music off, we stop and wash.

intro.caption: Tap, tap... freeze!
intro.parentCue: after each freeze, pretend to wash your hands

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening for stop and go.

classes.title: You and me, round we go
classes.goal: Make the song together: the grown-up plays the tune, the child keeps the beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two different jobs fit together to make one song

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune and watch your child; if they stop, keep playing and smile.
classes.childAction: Tap the beat on any key while your grown-up plays the tune.
classes.bridge: Two friends go round the bush hand in hand: one tune, one beat.

intro.caption: I play, you tap
intro.parentCue: sit side by side at the piano

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one song together, two jobs.

classes.title: Mulberry concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song from the first note to the last, then bow together.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song starts, goes on and ends; we finish together

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play the tune, then clap, cheer and bow together.
classes.childAction: Tap the beat to the very end, then take a big bow.
classes.bridge: The song goes once round the bush and stops where it began.

intro.caption: Concert time for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
